merge_experiments: merge multiple hiplot Experiment objects into a single combined Experiment
create_experiment_from_iterable: create a hiplot Experiment from a list of dictionaries with uid and value keys
create_experiment_from_dataframe: create a hiplot Experiment from a pandas DataFrame with uid column
create_experiment_from_optuna: create a hiplot Experiment from an Optuna study object with trial results
validate_experiment: validate a hiplot Experiment to check for circular references and missing parents
